args.title: checkout-api failing health checks after v2.3.1 deploy - rolled back to v2.3.0
args.summary: checkout-api began failing health checks after the v2.3.1 production deploy (error rate 0.18 across us-east, us-west, eu-west). Per the runbook, I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0, the most recent production release that was healthy, in all production regions. The rollback is VERIFIED and all three regions now run v2.3.0. v2.3.1 remains unhealthy and should be investigated before any redeploy. Follow-up: confirm error rate has recovered and review the v2.3.1 change.

trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all three production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west). The rollback is verified.

- **Why v2.3.0:** It is the most recent production release marked healthy. v2.3.1 was unhealthy and was running in every region with a 0.18 error rate.
- **Incident:** I opened SEV2 incident INC-0001 for checkout-api. It describes the failure and the rollback, and it paged on-call.

I haven't re-checked the error rate since the rollback, so it's worth confirming that checkout-api has recovered. v2.3.1 should be investigated before anyone redeploys it.

content.text: The latest production release that was healthy is v2.3.0. v2.3.1 is unhealthy and is running in all three regions, with a 0.18 error rate. I'll roll back to v2.3.0.
